moments.author: Victor Wembanyama / NBA
moments.quote: 52 PTS, 24 REB, 8 BLK – first player since 1974 with such a line. Career night amid virus and rolled ankle.
moments.why: Historic, jaw‑dropping performance from Wembanyama has everyone talking — pure athletic dominance.

moments.author: JD Vance
moments.quote: Midterms lost not because of turnout, but because Trump/Vance voters defected — war in Iran cost us.
moments.why: Gripping post‑mortem from the VP; political signal that’s fueling intra‑party debate among men 25‑45.

moments.author: Jim Jordan
moments.quote: Jordan throws hat in ring for House minority leader after midterm losses, battle with Scalise begins.
moments.why: Sharp move dives him into GOP power struggle; political drama that’s trending hard on X.

moments.author: Rep. Robert Garcia
moments.quote: "LAWYER UP" — caps popped after midterm results, now over 8.7M views.
moments.why: USA Democrats’ fiery reaction quickly went viral — encapsulates the mood around political accountability.
